_record: ADDITIVE corrected interpretation of the Stage D-2 C3 ATTEMPT-2 run. The raw run_manifest.json and provenance.json in this directory are PRESERVED BYTE-IDENTICALLY (as produced on the GPU host) and are NOT rewritten. This file is an append-only correction: the raw files carry a COARSE misclassification that this record supersedes.

run_manifest.json.raw_note: failure BEFORE the model forward — no scientific prediction occurred

approval.json.note: immutable execution-time snapshot of the activated attempt-2 external approval

why_the_raw_classification_is_coarse: The attempt-1-era wrapper decided BEFORE vs AFTER the forward solely from the existence of teacher_ef.json. A model forward that is INVOKED but fails INSIDE the model writes no teacher_ef.json (the executor writes it only after forward_fn returns), so the deterministically-invoked-but-failed model call was recorded as BEFORE_FORWARD. The raw TorchScript traceback in provenance.json proves the model WAS entered: grad_output.forward -> _graph_mixin.forward -> edge_norm.forward -> `r * rmax_recip`.

device_mismatch_detail.error: RuntimeError: Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but found at least two devices, cuda:1 and cpu
device_mismatch_detail.cuda1_side: the model buffer rmax_recip (edge-normalization _rmax_recip), on cuda:1 via torch.jit.load(map_location='cuda:1')
device_mismatch_detail.cpu_side: r (edge length), derived from the input positions, which build_model_input built with torch.tensor(...) on CPU and compute_neighborlist_ returned on CPU — never moved to the model device
device_mismatch_detail.category: input tensors (and neighbor-list output) remained on CPU while the model was on cuda:1

axis_status: Axis-A / Axis-B scientific status UNCHANGED — no valid E/F artifact exists; this is a runtime device-placement failure, NOT a scientific prediction and NOT a physical-validity result.

fix.adapter: runtimes/pydantic_ai/stage_d2_c3_teacher_adapter.py: build_model_input() now reads the model's ACTUAL device (from its params/buffers) and moves every input tensor onto it after compute_neighborlist_; forward-phase flags (forward_invoked/forward_completed) added so a DURING-forward failure is classified correctly.
fix.wrapper: work/stage_d2_c3_execute.py: failure state machine (PRE_FORWARD / FORWARD_STARTED / FORWARD_COMPLETED / ARTIFACT_COMMITTED) with EXECUTION_FAILED_BEFORE/DURING/AFTER_FORWARD, derived from the adapter phase flags, plus durable counters model_forward_invoked / model_forward_completed / valid_prediction_generated.
fix.new_preflight: work/stage_d2_c3_device_consistency_preflight.py: inspects every model param/buffer device + every input tensor device, fails closed on a CPU/CUDA mix, ZERO model calls — would have caught this before scientific execution.
